(2) The visual cuts to full-screen night footage of the Hong Kong high-rise fire. Massive vertical streaks of orange fire and black smoke dominate the frame. News-style subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) The shot returns to the host in the studio. A yellow cartoon speech bubble with a crying face appears next to him, containing text. He continues to speak with a serious expression and expressive hand movements. (4) A screenshot of a web article or news page is shown, discussing the fire and government policies regarding bamboo scaffolding. The host's voice continues in the background. (5) The host is shown again, now with more variety-show style text overlays and yellow question marks appearing around his head as he concludes the segment.
